item.title: France suspends stun grenade use at student protests after pupil loses hand
item.description:

Protesters’ weekslong blockade of schools is the most visible aspect of a multifaceted national crisis, as public workers strike, bond yields rise to multidecade highs , and France’s traditional parties reckon with the far-right.
